title: Breathing upward sewage breath
html_source:
Sand and mud flats are anaerobic and if you haven’t walked on one, they absolutely stink. Often the fauna will stick tubes out of the mud into the air to get some oxygen.

The resulting metabolism produces sulphides which reek to high heaven.
